unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: General coefficient-two asymptotic or exact 2n is already closed.
correct_statement: Every main current report explicitly leaves both unrestricted targets open.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: No original-problem counterexample is claimed.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: The supplied triple-factor proof directly proves M>=C n^2.
correct_statement: Its reconstruction proves M>=32 n^(5/2) and uses c^2 K>=1; this fails for fixed-C quadratic scaling. The separate stronger gate belongs to Wang.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: The quadratic statement itself is not disproved.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: A fixed-support or separated-band theorem applies to arbitrary growing support.
correct_statement: Keep support dependence and actual small/large factor restrictions; an arbitrary instance-dependent cutoff needs its own uniform error analysis.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: No counterexample to the source-class theorem.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: Optimality balances can be transferred to a top set selected at arbitrary weights.
correct_statement: Jointly maximize J_c over all cardinalities and weights so the full tail and its dual optimum are the same pair.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: The numerical full-tail counterexample has excess active 2-row supply and is nonoptimal.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: Whole prime-row tightness yields exact balance at each prime-power layer.
correct_statement: Sum all raw valuation levels before taking row excess; no independent levelwise equality follows.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: Accounting restriction, not a conjecture counterexample.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: Each root or core profile may use its own complete target hinge budget.
correct_statement: Use one union or one jointly clipped budget and control overlaps before summation.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: Several exact examples refute independent-root completion.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: The prime-conserving flow establishes the missing surplus bound.
correct_statement: Its exact deficiency on the minimal class is F-cm, the same unknown surplus.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: No positive arithmetic extremum is constructed.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: Small log-cap loss holds for every paired optimum without minimality.
correct_statement: The family A={p,2p,...,mp}, I=[1,M], w_p=1 has loss m-O(m/log M); necessary high-load/minimality hypotheses matter.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: Not a counterexample on the required minimal-obstruction class.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: Exact coverage or residual row accounting itself bounds the residual by a small quantity.
correct_statement: The residual is exactly still-selected mass outside the bank union; log-cap accounting must retain unused source budget.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: No sign or required upper bound follows from the identity.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: Bounded active occurrences imply a prime-count bound for collapsed source fibres.
correct_statement: Inactive cofactors create arbitrarily many actual sources with the same active carrier; use actual source multiplicities.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: The p1 p2 p3 u family is not a balanced optimum.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: Keeping inactive cofactors restores a bounded number of positive carriers per target.
correct_statement: One target divisible by their common multiple can contain arbitrarily many full carriers at the same bounded active load.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: Pointwise arithmetic counterexample to carrier summation, not to 708.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: Same-threshold prefix-to-interval hinge error is uniformly o(M).
correct_statement: An actual CRT family has positive linear H1 discrepancy; the desired two-threshold coefficient-two problem survives.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: The displayed dual still lies below 2n.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: The complete top tail guarantees coordinatewise bank-product domination.
correct_statement: The exact p-row example has demand 10353 versus bank supply 10352; actual paired optimality fails in its 2-row.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: Neither J_weak on true optima nor the asymptotic is refuted.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: o(n) distinct minimally hot roots imply o(n) fixed-union discrepancy.
correct_statement: Roots 2p in the documented full-tail family have a linear union loss; exact active-row balance excludes the family.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: Counterexample retains many weak normalizations but is not a genuine paired optimum.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: Unamplified uniform cofactor routing always has congestion <=delta n.
correct_statement: The one-prime full tail has asymptotic congestion/n=5/128; cluster credit or amplified capture is a different route.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: Its J_c is negative, so no positive-global-extremum lemma is disproved.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: Pairwise cold gcd intersections automatically permit arbitrary simultaneous payment.
correct_statement: Weights 0.4 on 2,3,5,7 and roots 30,42,70,105 give total root excess 0.8 at target 210 with hinge 0.6.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: An overlap-accounting counterexample, not an entire source-cover counterexample.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: A universal nonnegative pointwise divisor kernel can reach every threshold above two.
correct_statement: On the exact six-coordinate grid such kernels require threshold at least 13/6. Signed or arithmetic summed certificates are not excluded.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: Formal incidence-system obstruction; not an actual interval counterexample.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: The three/four-prime dot certificate normalizes every optimal core.
correct_statement: The repaired proof requires an actual periodic core; it handles repeated primes and relative errors inside that hypothesis.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: A proven restricted certificate is not an unrestricted core reduction.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: The diffuse bank model inherits additive weights, optimality and all original row identities.
correct_statement: The model can be nonadditive; only the proved one-sided joint transfer is justified. Keep original row balances separately.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: No counterexample to the proved transfer.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: Shrinking eta may be followed by a fixed-depth heavy-carrier proof without checking constants.
correct_statement: The heavy degree L/eta grows; capture amplification must be fixed before eta or satisfy Lambda(eta)psi(eta)->0 quantitatively.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: Missing uniformity, not a refutation of the target.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: Deleted short-bank or high-load sources disappear from subsequent exact row identities.
correct_statement: Their row demand remains as an explicit controlled error term; it is not literally zero.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: The full-original-source scale identity remains valid.

unsafe_claim_or_shortcut: Finite solver or matching searches prove the unrestricted inequality.
correct_statement: Exact certificates prove their specified finite statements; timeouts, nonfindings, and floating-point solver bounds are not global proof certificates.
counterexample_scope_or_limit: No new g(n) computation in the latest general-target work.
